outcome: maternal intestinal markers (zonulin, intestinal alkaline phosphatase activity, faecal calprotectin)
cohort: 73 mother-neonate pairs from the longitudinal MAMI cohort
finding: Maternal diet during pregnancy, mainly fat intake, was related to intestinal markers, thus likely shifting the microbial transmission to the neonate and influencing the neonatal microbial profile.
mod_finding: The association between maternal diet and neonatal microbiota at birth was influenced by mode of delivery.
